raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On SM12x, ModelOpt static-FP8 linears can change reduction schedules between cold prefill and a shorter prefix-cache-hit batch despite deterministic inference being enabled. The same input sequence then receives different scores.

Related to #41351's ModelOpt path. Credit to `furedericca-lab` for the [diagnosis and initial fallback](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/41351#issuecomment-5847506820), and `twu3202` for [identifying the small-M gap](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/41351#issuecomment-5853051517). This does not claim to resolve every hybrid/GDN issue in that thread.

## Modifications

- In **SM12x deterministic mode only**, reuse Triton scaled MM with fixed N=64/K=128 reduction tiles. M-only tiles 16/32/128 reduce decode waste and improve long-prefill occupancy while retaining exact per-row results. Normal-mode and forced-Marlin dispatch remain unchanged.
- Zero masked A/B loads for partial K tiles.
- Extend the existing SM120 test file with 12 cold/cache row comparisons and two CUDA Graph replay cases covering strided 3D input, bias, BF16/FP16 output and a K=80 tail.

## Accuracy Tests

RTX 5090, 400W, TP=1, `nvidia/Qwen3-8B-FP8` at `2cebc4c89e25abc17668c81b01dceaf3d8b914d5`, BF16 output, Triton attention, deterministic mode.

| Check | Baseline | Candidate |
|---|---|---|
| 12 cold/cache native-method cases | 4 failed / 8 passed | 12 passed |
| Complete current SM120 test file | — | **137 passed**, including two new Graph cases |
| Prefixes 128/1024/4096, batches 1/4/2, two repetitions, eager and Graph | selected-score deltas up to 2.500 | **0 in all 12 comparisons**; warm repeats also 0 |
| Disjoint GSM8K rows 32–159, zero-shot greedy, thinking disabled, cap 512 | 119/128 | 117/128 |
| No parseable numeric final answer in that sample | 1 | 2 |

The row-tile optimization is bit-exact against the initial fixed-M=32 candidate in 120 isolated comparisons and produces **identical complete text on all 128 real-model evaluation questions**. The evaluation contains different reasoning errors and answer-format/truncation effects between baseline and candidate; it establishes neither a general accuracy gain nor statistical equivalence.

[Native test log](https://github.com/yibol9768-alt/sglang/blob/fd948aa99130c601e1f35b50b260edf15d79c11e/validation/rtx5090-20261017/round2/evidence/fp8-rowtiles-full-tests.log), [long-prefix Graph results](https://github.com/yibol9768-alt/sglang/blob/fd948aa99130c601e1f35b50b260edf15d79c11e/validation/rtx5090-20261017/round2/evidence/sglang-fp8-extended-patched-rowtiles-graph.json), [paired evaluation](https://github.com/yibol9768-alt/sglang/blob/fd948aa99130c601e1f35b50b260edf15d79c11e/validation/rtx5090-20261017/round2/evidence/sglang-heldout128-comparison.json), [scripts, versions and raw outputs](https://github.com/yibol9768-alt/sglang/blob/fd948aa99130c601e1f35b50b260edf15d79c11e/validation/rtx5090-20261017/round2/README.md).

Runtime: SGLang 0.5.21 compiled dependencies with the changed main-source Python definitions; affected baseline ASTs match main. This is not a complete main rebuild or upstream CI. The original hybrid TP=2 model, other SM12x devices and torch.compile were not tested locally. The existing registered test file remains SM120-gated.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Four workloads below use 32 forced output tokens per request, one warmup and five measured repetitions. Values are end-to-end medians; cooling to ≤55°C occurs outside each measurement. Graph runs capture decode batches 1/2/4 and prefill token sizes 4/128/256/1024/2048/4096/8192; unsupported partial prefills may fall back to eager.

| Prefix tokens / batch | Eager baseline → candidate | Graph baseline → candidate |
|---|---:|---:|
| 128 / 1 | 1.626s → 1.778s | 0.284s → 0.336s |
| 128 / 4 | 2.423s → 1.776s | 0.404s → 0.426s |
| 2048 / 1 | 1.666s → 1.784s | 0.500s → 0.597s |
| 2048 / 4 | 2.791s → 2.284s | 0.857s → 0.993s |

Graph wall time remains about **5–20% higher** on this measured matrix. This is an opt-in determinism fix with a measured cost, not a general speedup claim. Full samples and ranges are in the [benchmark records](https://github.com/yibol9768-alt/sglang/blob/fd948aa99130c601e1f35b50b260edf15d79c11e/validation/rtx5090-20261017/round2/README.md).

Duplicate check: inspected #34429 (small-M dispatch), #42865 (block/MXFP8), #38921 (SM89 prequantized inputs) and #44076 (GDN chunk alignment); these do not implement this static per-tensor deterministic path. [Original pinned diff audit](https://github.com/yibol9768-alt/sglang/blob/ca72d5212b33ab079f838144467a870de749e859/validation/rtx5090-20261017/evidence/final-diff-audit.json).

AI assistance was used for diagnosis, implementation, validation and this description. The human contributor reviewed the original fix and authorized the additional validation and PR updates.

## Checklist

- [x] Applicable pre-commit hooks pass.
- [x] Focused regressions extend the existing registered file.
- [x] Real pretrained-model correctness, quality and performance checks are recorded with limitations.
- [x] No new public invocation or interface; behavior and tradeoffs are documented here.

## Review and Merge Process

Maintainer review and upstream CI follow the normal project process. Local validation does not replace upstream CI.

@@ -2381,6 +2381,39 @@ def use_aiter_bpreshuffle_gemm(output_size: int) -> bool:
     return _use_aiter and output_size % 64 == 0
 
 
+def apply_fp8_linear_deterministic(
+    input: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    input_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    bias: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Static FP8 linear with one reduction schedule across batch sizes."""
+    output_shape = [*input.shape[:-1], weight.shape[1]]
+    input_2d = input.reshape(-1, input.shape[-1]).contiguous()
+    qinput, x_scale = static_quant_fp8(input_2d, input_scale, repeat_scale=False)
+    # Keep K reduction and N tiling fixed so prefill and cache hits agree.
+    # Only the row tile varies, avoiding wasted decode work and small tiles
+    # on long prefills without changing each row's reduction.
+    m = input_2d.shape[0]
+    block_m = 16 if m <= 16 else 32 if m < 128 else 128
+    output = triton_scaled_mm(
+        qinput,
+        weight,
+        x_scale,
+        weight_scale,
+        input.dtype,
+        bias,
+        block_size_m=block_m,
+        block_size_n=64,
+        block_size_k=128,
+        use_heuristic=False,
+        num_warps=4,
+        num_stages=2,
+    )
+    return output.view(*output_shape)
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("small_m,large_m", [(1, 64), (8, 128), (120, 248)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("n,k", [(4096, 4096), (16384, 5120), (5120, 6144), (96, 80)])
+def test_deterministic_modelopt_fp8_preserves_cached_suffix(
+    monkeypatch, small_m, large_m, n, k
+):
+    """Cold prefill and a shorter cache-hit batch must score identical rows."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        modelopt_quant,
+        "get_exec",
+        lambda: SimpleNamespace(
+            deterministic=SimpleNamespace(enable_deterministic_inference=True)
+        ),
+        raising=False,
+    )
+    method = object.__new__(modelopt_quant.ModelOptFp8LinearMethod)
+    method.use_marlin = False
+    method.use_sm120_fp8 = True
+    method.cutlass_fp8_supported = True
+    x, weight, weight_scale, input_scale = _make_inputs(large_m, n, k, seed=29)
+    layer = SimpleNamespace(
+        weight=weight,
+        weight_scale=weight_scale,
+        input_scale=input_scale,
+        sm120_fp8_alpha=input_scale * weight_scale,
+        use_flashinfer_bmm=True,
+    )
+    full = method.apply(layer, x)
+    suffix = method.apply(layer, x[-small_m:].contiguous())
+    torch.testing.assert_close(suffix, full[-small_m:], rtol=0, atol=0)
+    quantized, _ = static_quant_fp8(x, input_scale, repeat_scale=False)
+    reference = (quantized.float() @ weight.float()) * input_scale * weight_scale
+    relative_rmse = (
+        full.float() - reference
+    ).square().mean().sqrt() / reference.square().mean().sqrt().clamp_min(1e-8)
+    assert relative_rmse < 0.005
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.bfloat16, torch.float16])
+def test_deterministic_fp8_graph_replay_with_bias_and_strided_input(dtype):
+    deterministic_linear = modelopt_quant.apply_fp8_linear_deterministic
+    x, weight, weight_scale, input_scale = _make_inputs(6, 96, 80, seed=17)
+    x = x.to(dtype).view(2, 3, 80).transpose(0, 1)
+    bias = torch.randn(96, dtype=dtype, device="cuda")
+    args = (x, weight, weight_scale, input_scale, bias)
+    deterministic_linear(*args)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        actual = deterministic_linear(*args)
+
+    graph.replay()
+    before = actual.clone()
+    x.copy_(torch.randn_like(x).mul_(2))
+    graph.replay()
+    expected = deterministic_linear(*args)
+    assert actual.shape == (3, 2, 96)
+    assert actual.dtype == dtype
+    assert not torch.equal(actual, before)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+    quantized, _ = static_quant_fp8(
+        x.reshape(-1, 80).contiguous(), input_scale, repeat_scale=False
+    )
+    reference = (
+        (quantized.float() @ weight.float()) * input_scale * weight_scale + bias
+    ).view_as(actual)
+    relative_rmse = (actual.float() - reference).square().mean().sqrt() / (
+        reference.square().mean().sqrt().clamp_min(1e-8)
+    )
+    assert relative_rmse < 0.005
+
+
